action.description: start a scan of a folder, step an existing one, or remove the scans named in scan_ids. A scan is otherwise kept until it expires (scan_retention_days after its last write).

path.description: start: the folder to scan, as the identity's own tools name it — relative to its home, or absolute inside a folder its operator granted it (Settings → Sandbox).

exclude.description: start: gitignore-style patterns to leave out, relative to path.

include_tests.description: start: judge test files too (default false). Tests can be a large share of a source tree, and each file costs about two judge calls, so include them when the tests themselves are what you want measured.

include_generated.description: start: judge generated and minified files too (default false). They are otherwise out of scope. It does not lift the 1 MiB ceiling.

max_files.description: start: stop after this many files (default 30000).

scan_ids.description: remove: the scans to remove, by id. Every one must exist, or nothing is removed.

scan_id.description: step: the scan to advance; start: an optional name for the new scan (letters, digits, _ and -).
